svg.title: Atomic motion in a real kUPS argon trajectory
svg.desc: A top-down view of one 32-atom layer selected from a 256-atom argon crystal. Four atoms are highlighted with force arrows. The animation uses one hundred recorded frames from a ten-picosecond kUPS NVE simulation.
svg.text: Thermal motion in a real argon trajectory
256-atom kUPS NVE run · one 32-atom lattice layer · 2 fs timestep · positions not magnified
